    Whether a live-layer failure is a genuine rejection (a plan defect) or an infeasibility (a skip).
    PlanValidator.Result
    The outcome of validating a plan, in three distinct buckets — hard/rejection errors (which invalidate the plan), deferred validations (which do NOT — they run at provisioning), and skipped validations (which do NOT — they could not be attempted now, each with a reason) — plus the per-connection customer inputs a first-time customer must gather.
